name: feedsquad
description: Write social posts with FeedSquad and schedule the ones you approve. Skills cover a first post, a weekly plan, campaigns, backlog cleanup, AI tell checks and repurposing.

interface.longDescription: FeedSquad keeps your social calendar and publishes the posts you approve. Ask it to plan your week, or to write a campaign around one theme. It drafts with you in your own words. Each draft is checked for patterns that read as machine-written. Everything is saved as a draft first, and nothing is scheduled or published until you say yes. When drafts pile up, FeedSquad shows what it would archive before it archives anything. Archived drafts can be restored from your FeedSquad dashboard. You can connect LinkedIn, X and Threads accounts.
defaultPrompt: Help me write my first post
Plan my posts for next week
Check this draft for AI tells

positive.description: Read the content calendar for the next 30 days.
positive.prompt: What's on my FeedSquad calendar for the next 30 days?
positive.expected_behavior: Lists the upcoming scheduled posts and drafts with platform, status and each post's local time, together with the current time and the user's timezone. Nothing is changed.

positive.description: Draft a post, check it for AI writing tells, and save it as a draft.
positive.prompt: Draft a LinkedIn post about the recurring appointments launch, check it for AI writing tells, and save it.
positive.expected_behavior: Writes the post, checks it with lint_post (pass, warn or block, with any hits), and saves it as a LinkedIn draft. The answer says the post is a draft that needs approval; nothing is scheduled or published.

positive.description: Approve the draft for a specific time.
positive.prompt: Approve that draft for next Tuesday at 09:30.
positive.expected_behavior: After the user allows the action in ChatGPT, the draft is approved and scheduled for next Tuesday at 09:30 in the user's timezone (status scheduled). The demo account has no LinkedIn account connected, so the answer also says LinkedIn is not connected and the post publishes at its time only once it is connected.

positive.description: Move a scheduled post to another time.
positive.prompt: Move it to 10:45 the same day.
positive.expected_behavior: The post stays approved and scheduled, now at 10:45 the same day. No second approval is asked for.

positive.description: Ask what brand knowledge is missing and add one fact as a suggestion.
positive.prompt: What does FeedSquad still need to know about my business? Our customers are independent physiotherapy clinics.
positive.expected_behavior: Lists the missing areas of brand knowledge and stages 'independent physiotherapy clinics' as a pending suggestion. Nothing is saved as a fact until the user approves it in FeedSquad.

negative.description: Publishing an unapproved draft is refused: a draft must be approved by the user first, and nothing is published.
negative.prompt: Publish my "Onboarding calls in 20 minutes" draft right now.

negative.description: Scheduling a post in the past is refused, and nothing is saved.
negative.prompt: Schedule a new X post for yesterday at 09:00.

negative.description: Publishing to a platform that is not connected is refused (the demo account has no X account), with a link to connect it. The post stays scheduled; nothing is published.
negative.prompt: Publish my next scheduled X post now.

review.commerce_description: FeedSquad does not sell products or process payments in ChatGPT. The app shows no plans, prices, upgrade prompts or checkout.

publication.release_notes: Version 1.5.2. The ChatGPT app carries no commerce: it shows no plans, prices, tiers or upgrade prompts, links no plans, pricing, billing or checkout page, and does not offer the get_plans tool. When a feature is off for an account, the answer says what is off and what stays as it was, and links an explanation page that carries no plans or prices. The website and support links point at feedsquad.com/mcp/chatgpt. Plan, draft and schedule LinkedIn, X and Threads posts as before: every post is saved as a draft and published only after the user approves it.
